source_name: DreamJobs.hu (IT-focused HU job portal)
why_relevant: Niche IT board with rich, engineer-written ads and per-company pages (Dorsum, OTP Mobil). Ads here are more technically explicit than generic boards, so platform/vendor names appear more often.

source_name: HWSW karrier (IT news site job section)
why_relevant: Hungary's main IT trade magazine also runs a job section; combines editorial context with ads, so a vendor's hiring push often appears here alongside coverage of the deal driving it.

source_name: Hays Hungary job search + Salary Guide
why_relevant: Specialist recruiter with explicit Banking & Financial Services and IT Contracting practices in Budapest. Agency ads describe client programmes anonymously but concretely ('leading retail bank, core migration, Java/Temenos'), and the annual Salary Guide quantifies which banking-tech skills are in demand — a market-level demand signal.

source_name: Randstad Hungary job listings & IT job profiles
why_relevant: Large staffing firm supplying contractors to bank IT programmes; its HU listings and IT job-profile pages give both live demand and the local-language canonical titles used for banking-tech roles (useful for glossary building).

source_name: Temenos careers (Workday ATS) — EMEA/Hungary filter
why_relevant: Core-banking vendor ATS. Any Budapest-located requisition (implementation consultant, delivery, support) is strong evidence of a Hungarian client engagement or a delivery-centre build-out; requisition text often names the product line (Transact, Infinity).

source_name: Diebold Nixdorf careers (Oracle Cloud CX ATS)
why_relevant: Global ATM/self-service vendor and a direct competitor in HU ATM estates; Hungary-located field-service, project or software requisitions indicate estate wins, managed-services contracts or service-model changes at HU banks.

source_name: Glassdoor — Hungary company job & review pages
why_relevant: Carries per-company HU openings plus employee reviews/interview reports that occasionally disclose internal platform names and project names not present in the ad text — an unusually rich indirect leak channel for vendor stacks.

source_name: Állástérkép.hu (map-based HU job portal)
why_relevant: Geo-indexed HU job listings; useful for detecting a vendor opening a physical Budapest/regional delivery or field-service site, which is exactly the market-entry signal this cell is meant to catch.

source_name: BankWeb.hu banki állás section
why_relevant: Sector-specific HU portal aggregating 'banki állás' links; a cheap pointer to the full set of HU bank career pages, including smaller institutions (savings banks, MFB, Gránit, Magnet) that mainstream enumeration misses.

source_name: Mindspire — HU core-banking transformation consultancy (blog + services + hiring)
why_relevant: Body-shop/consultancy staffing HU core-banking programmes. Its blog explicitly tracks the status of Hungarian core-banking renewal projects, and its recruitment of business analysts/system organisers correlates with which bank's programme is ramping — a pointer that converts hiring signals into named programmes.

source_name: Core Solutions Kft. (HU banking system-integration staffing firm)
why_relevant: Supplies banking/system-integration and test-management specialists to HU financial institutions; its openings and reference claims indicate which integration and testing programmes are live in the market.

source_name: Portfolio.hu Rendezvények – conference hub (all events)
why_relevant: Master index of Portfolio's Hungarian banking/finance/IT conference series (Banking Technology, Financial IT, Future of Finance, Hitelezés). Each event has stable sub-pages for program (program), speakers (eloadok) and sponsors/supporters (tamogatok), making it the single best entry point to enumerate who sells into Hungarian banking and at what sponsor tier.

source_name: Portfolio Banking Technology 2025 – sponsors page (támogatók)
why_relevant: Explicit tiered sponsor list for Hungary's flagship banking-technology conference (10th edition, 4 Nov 2025, Budapest Marriott). Observed tiers include Platinum: Visa; Super Gold: OTP Bank; Gold: Gránit Bank, K&H Bank; plus a Silver tier of technology/financial vendors, and 60+ confirmed participating companies. Sponsor tier is a direct proxy for who is willing to spend to reach Hungarian banking buyers.

source_name: Portfolio Banking Technology – historical editions archive (2017–2025)
why_relevant: Prior-year editions remain online with their own program/speaker/sponsor pages (2017, 2019, 2020, 2022, 2023, 2024 seen in results), giving a ~9-year longitudinal series of which vendors sponsored Hungarian banking IT and which bank executives shared a stage with which supplier. The 2019 participant list already names 4iG Nyrt., ACI Worldwide, Accenture Kft., adesso Hungary.

source_name: Portfolio Financial IT konferencia (2025, 2026 editions)
why_relevant: Sister event explicitly framed as bringing together senior bank executives, IT decision-makers, regulators, fintechs and 'the major banking IT suppliers' (nagy banki IT-beszállítók). 2026 edition: 28 May 2026, Budapest Marriott. Speaker roster is effectively a supplier-to-bank map for core banking, payments and channel technology.

source_name: Portfolio Future of Finance konferencia (2025, 2026)
why_relevant: Strategy-level banking conference (2026 edition 23 Sept 2026) whose sponsor tiers and panel line-ups reveal which vendors and which banks are pairing publicly; useful for partnership disclosure and for competitor positioning at C-level rather than IT level.

source_name: FinTechShow / BankTechShow / PayTechShow (FinTechZone events)
why_relevant: Self-described largest Hungarian fintech gathering ('a legnagyobb fintech seregszemle Magyarországon'), with explicit sponsor grades — Főszponzor, Aranyfokozatú, Ezüstfokozatú, Bronzfokozatú szponzor — plus a separate exhibitor (kiállítók) category. Runs a paired BankTechShow + FinTechShow (Sept 2025) and a combined jubilee TechShow X on 14–15 Oct 2026 at Várkert Bazár. Exhibitor tier is where smaller POS/payments vendors surface that never appear in Portfolio's sponsor list.

source_name: FinTechZone – Hungarian fintech trade portal / event & award reporting
why_relevant: Organiser of the *TechShow series and the main HU-language outlet reporting award outcomes (e.g. BinX named winner of the FinTechShow award; K&H repeatedly 'best digital bank in Hungary'). Its category pages (magyar fintech startupok) are a rolling actor list for the Hungarian fintech supply side.

source_name: Mastercard – Év Bankja (Bank of the Year) awards
why_relevant: The most prominent Hungarian banking award programme, sponsored by Mastercard, with segment categories (Daily Banking, Innovation, Beyond Banking) and a professional jury. 2025 outcome: OTP Bank overall; Gránit Bank in Innovation; K&H Bank in Beyond Banking. Category-level winners identify which banks are publicly staking a claim on digital/innovation and therefore buying technology.

source_name: Felelős Fintech Tartalmakért pályázat és díj – díjazottak
why_relevant: Dedicated Hungarian fintech award with a published winners page; smaller than Év Bankja but surfaces niche fintech and content/communication actors that larger awards miss. Useful for completing the long tail of the HU fintech actor map.

source_name: IVSZ – Szövetség a Digitális Gazdaságért: events and Gyurós Tibor-díj
why_relevant: The Hungarian ICT industry association co-hosts fintech events (e.g. FINTECHSHOW 6.0 listed in its event calendar) and awards the Gyurós Tibor-díj, whose 2025/2026 recipients explicitly spanned health-IT, cybersecurity, FINANCIAL and innovation fields — categories include manager of the year, digitalisation project of the year, innovation of the year. Award citations name both the supplier and the customer project, which is a partnership disclosure.

source_name: Magyar Innovációs Nagydíj (Hungarian Innovation Grand Prize) – NKFIH / Magyar Innovációs Szövetség
why_relevant: National-level innovation award whose category winners have included financial technology actors (e.g. Péntech Solutions Kft. won the Startup Innovation Award for digital SME financing; an IT development took the 2024 Grand Prize). Award dossiers describe the deployed solution and its customer, giving verified case-study leads.

source_name: IT Business (itbusiness.hu) – Hungarian enterprise-IT trade magazine, award and conference coverage
why_relevant: Named in the cell brief as an award/rankings source. Confirmed to cover Hungarian IT award outcomes (Magyar Innovációs Nagydíj 2024) and enterprise-IT vendor activity; its annual rankings and event coverage are a secondary route to sponsor/exhibitor names when organiser pages are thin. NOTE: I did not find a distinct branded 'IT Business díj' — see negative findings.

source_name: MNB (Magyar Nemzeti Bank) – Lámfalussy Lectures Conference
why_relevant: Central bank's flagship annual conference (since 2014; 10th edition in 2025 with the PM attending), drawing partner central banks, heads of international and domestic financial institutions. Attendee/speaker lists map the regulator-to-bank-to-institution network and signal MNB policy priorities that drive bank IT spending. English mirror pages exist.

source_name: MNB – Budapest Eurasia Forum / international central-bank partnerships page
why_relevant: Documents MNB's event partnerships — the Singapore Fintech Festival is named an official partner of the Budapest Eurasia Forum, alongside the BoK International Conference. Institutional event partnerships indicate which fintech ecosystems the Hungarian regulator is channelling into the local market.

source_name: IIR Hungary – Kártyapiac / Digital Payment conference series
why_relevant: Long-running commercial conference organiser whose Kártyapiac (Card Market) series is described as the only comprehensive domestic event on cards/mobile payments; speaker lists have named GRÁNIT Pay, K&H Bank and the MKB FinTech Program, and topics cover card-acceptance market change in CEE — directly on the POS/acquiring axis. Site has a dedicated szponzoráció section listing sponsorship packages and highlighted events.

source_name: businessevents.hu – Digital Payment konferencia (AFR 2.0 focus)
why_relevant: Dedicated Hungarian digital-payments conference organised around AFR 2.0 (the instant payment scheme upgrade) — the single most payment-vendor-dense HU event type. The site has an együttműködés/kiemelt rendezvények (partnership/highlighted events) structure that exposes sponsor and partner companies.

source_name: Hungarian Fintech Association (HFA) – events page
why_relevant: The national fintech association's events listing aggregates HU fintech events and co-organiser/partner names; the association itself co-organises Budapest Fintech Week. Its membership and partner lists are a compact actor map of the Hungarian fintech supply side.
